visual_identity.body: Slender, flexible body with a long tail; legs are positioned more underneath the body for high-walking/running. Soft, pebbled skin textures.
visual_identity.coloration: Mottled 'Pale lavender' and 'Dull green' to camouflage with the riverbank silt and moss.
visual_identity.face: Very large, warm golden eyes with 'Disney-style' expressive brows. A short, rounded snout that looks more 'dog-like' and friendly than a modern alligator.
visual_identity.no_text_constraint: True. Facial expressions must communicate all emotions (curiosity, joy, sleepiness).

personality: Playful, observant, and quick; a 'scout' of the river valleys.
